# Subagent-Driven Development

Execute plan by dispatching fresh subagent per task, with two-stage review after each: spec compliance review first, then code quality review.

**Core principle:** Fresh subagent per task + two-stage review (spec then quality) = high quality, fast iteration

## When to Use

```dot
digraph when_to_use {
    "Have implementation plan?" [shape=diamond];
    "Tasks mostly independent?" [shape=diamond];
    "Stay in this session?" [shape=diamond];
    "subagent-driven-development" [shape=box];
    "executing-plans" [shape=box];
    "Manual execution or brainstorm first" [shape=box];

    "Have implementation plan?" -> "Tasks mostly independent?" [label="yes"];
    "Have implementation plan?" -> "Manual execution or brainstorm first" [label="no"];
    "Tasks mostly independent?" -> "Stay in this session?" [label="yes"];
    "Tasks mostly independent?" -> "Manual execution or brainstorm first" [label="no - tightly coupled"];
    "Stay in this session?" -> "subagent-driven-development" [label="yes"];
    "Stay in this session?" -> "executing-plans" [label="no - parallel session"];
}
```

**vs. Executing Plans (parallel session):**
- Same session (no context switch)
- Fresh subagent per task (no context pollution)
- Two-stage review after each task: spec compliance first, then code quality
- Faster iteration (no human-in-loop between tasks)

## The Process

```dot
digraph process {
    rankdir=TB;

    subgraph cluster_per_task {
        label="Per Task";
        "Dispatch implementer subagent (./implementer-prompt.md)" [shape=box];
        "Implementer subagent asks questions?" [shape=diamond];
        "Answer questions, provide context" [shape=box];
        "Implementer subagent implements, tests, commits, self-reviews" [shape=box];
        "Dispatch spec reviewer subagent (./spec-reviewer-prompt.md)" [shape=box];
        "Spec reviewer subagent confirms code matches spec?" [shape=diamond];
        "Implementer subagent fixes spec gaps" [shape=box];
        "Dispatch code quality reviewer subagent (./code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md)" [shape=box];
        "Code quality reviewer subagent approves?" [shape=diamond];
        "Implementer subagent fixes quality issues" [shape=box];
        "Mark task complete in TodoWrite" [shape=box];
    }

    "Read plan, extract all tasks with full text, note context, create TodoWrite" [shape=box];
    "More tasks remain?" [shape=diamond];
    "Dispatch final code reviewer subagent for entire implementation" [shape=box];
    "Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch" [shape=box style=filled fillcolor=lightgreen];

    "Read plan, extract all tasks with full text, note context, create TodoWrite" -> "Dispatch implementer subagent (./implementer-prompt.md)";
    "Dispatch implementer subagent (./implementer-prompt.md)" -> "Implementer subagent asks questions?";
    "Implementer subagent asks questions?" -> "Answer questions, provide context" [label="yes"];
    "Answer questions, provide context" -> "Dispatch implementer subagent (./implementer-prompt.md)";
    "Implementer subagent asks questions?" -> "Implementer subagent implements, tests, commits, self-reviews" [label="no"];
    "Implementer subagent implements, tests, commits, self-reviews" -> "Dispatch spec reviewer subagent (./spec-reviewer-prompt.md)";
    "Dispatch spec reviewer subagent (./spec-reviewer-prompt.md)" -> "Spec reviewer subagent confirms code matches spec?";
    "Spec reviewer subagent confirms code matches spec?" -> "Implementer subagent fixes spec gaps" [label="no"];
    "Implementer subagent fixes spec gaps" -> "Dispatch spec reviewer subagent (./spec-reviewer-prompt.md)" [label="re-review"];
    "Spec reviewer subagent confirms code matches spec?" -> "Dispatch code quality reviewer subagent (./code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md)" [label="yes"];
    "Dispatch code quality reviewer subagent (./code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md)" -> "Code quality reviewer subagent approves?";
    "Code quality reviewer subagent approves?" -> "Implementer subagent fixes quality issues" [label="no"];
    "Implementer subagent fixes quality issues" -> "Dispatch code quality reviewer subagent (./code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md)" [label="re-review"];
    "Code quality reviewer subagent approves?" -> "Mark task complete in TodoWrite" [label="yes"];
    "Mark task complete in TodoWrite" -> "More tasks remain?";
    "More tasks remain?" -> "Dispatch implementer subagent (./implementer-prompt.md)" [label="yes"];
    "More tasks remain?" -> "Dispatch final code reviewer subagent for entire implementation" [label="no"];
    "Dispatch final code reviewer subagent for entire implementation" -> "Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch";
}
```

## Prompt Templates

- `./implementer-prompt.md` - Dispatch implementer subagent
- `./spec-reviewer-prompt.md` - Dispatch spec compliance reviewer subagent
- `./code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md` - Dispatch code quality reviewer subagent

## Example Workflow

```
You: I'm using Subagent-Driven Development to execute this plan.

[Read plan file once: docs/plans/feature-plan.md]
[Extract all 5 tasks with full text and context]
[Create TodoWrite with all tasks]

Task 1: Hook installation script

[Get Task 1 text and context (already extracted)]
[Dispatch implementation subagent with full task text + context]

Implementer: "Before I begin - should the hook be installed at user or system level?"

You: "User level (~/.config/superpowers/hooks/)"

Implementer: "Got it. Implementing now..."
[Later] Implementer:
  - Implemented install-hook command
  - Added tests, 5/5 passing
  - Self-review: Found I missed --force flag, added it
  - Committed

[Dispatch spec compliance reviewer]
Spec reviewer: ✅ Spec compliant - all requirements met, nothing extra

[Get git SHAs, dispatch code quality reviewer]
Code reviewer: Strengths: Good test coverage, clean. Issues: None. Approved.

[Mark Task 1 complete]

Task 2: Recovery modes

[Get Task 2 text and context (already extracted)]
[Dispatch implementation subagent with full task text + context]

Implementer: [No questions, proceeds]
Implementer:
  - Added verify/repair modes
  - 8/8 tests passing
  - Self-review: All good
  - Committed

[Dispatch spec compliance reviewer]
Spec reviewer: ❌ Issues:
  - Missing: Progress reporting (spec says "report every 100 items")
  - Extra: Added --json flag (not requested)

[Implementer fixes issues]
Implementer: Removed --json flag, added progress reporting

[Spec reviewer reviews again]
Spec reviewer: ✅ Spec compliant now

[Dispatch code quality reviewer]
Code reviewer: Strengths: Solid. Issues (Important): Magic number (100)

[Implementer fixes]
Implementer: Extracted PROGRESS_INTERVAL constant

[Code reviewer reviews again]
Code reviewer: ✅ Approved

[Mark Task 2 complete]

...

[After all tasks]
[Dispatch final code-reviewer]
Final reviewer: All requirements met, ready to merge

Done!
```

## Advantages

**vs. Manual execution:**
- Subagents follow TDD naturally
- Fresh context per task (no confusion)
- Parallel-safe (subagents don't interfere)
- Subagent can ask questions (before AND during work)

**vs. Executing Plans:**
- Same session (no handoff)
- Continuous progress (no waiting)
- Review checkpoints automatic

**Efficiency gains:**
- No file reading overhead (controller provides full text)
- Controller curates exactly what context is needed
- Subagent gets complete information upfront
- Questions surfaced before work begins (not after)

**Quality gates:**
- Self-review catches issues before handoff
- Two-stage review: spec compliance, then code quality
- Review loops ensure fixes actually work
- Spec compliance prevents over/under-building
- Code quality ensures implementation is well-built

**Cost:**
- More subagent invocations (implementer + 2 reviewers per task)
- Controller does more prep work (extracting all tasks upfront)
- Review loops add iterations
- But catches issues early (cheaper than debugging later)

## Red Flags

**Never:**
- Skip reviews (spec compliance OR code quality)
- Proceed with unfixed issues
- Dispatch multiple implementation subagents in parallel (conflicts)
- Make subagent read plan file (provide full text instead)
- Skip scene-setting context (subagent needs to understand where task fits)
- Ignore subagent questions (answer before letting them proceed)
- Accept "close enough" on spec compliance (spec reviewer found issues = not done)
- Skip review loops (reviewer found issues = implementer fixes = review again)
- Let implementer self-review replace actual review (both are needed)
- **Start code quality review before spec compliance is ✅** (wrong order)
- Move to next task while either review has open issues

**If subagent asks questions:**
- Answer clearly and completely
- Provide additional context if needed
- Don't rush them into implementation

**If reviewer finds issues:**
- Implementer (same subagent) fixes them
- Reviewer reviews again
- Repeat until approved
- Don't skip the re-review

**If subagent fails task:**
- Dispatch fix subagent with specific instructions
- Don't try to fix manually (context pollution)

## Integration

**Required workflow skills:**
- **superpowers:writing-plans** - Creates the plan this skill executes
- **superpowers:requesting-code-review** - Code review template for reviewer subagents
- **superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch** - Complete development after all tasks

**Subagents should use:**
- **superpowers:test-driven-development** - Subagents follow TDD for each task

**Alternative workflow:**
- **superpowers:executing-plans** - Use for parallel session instead of same-session execution

   852→```python
   853→#!/usr/bin/env python3
   854→"""Download YouTube audio locally and upload to Azure Blob Storage.
   855→
   856→Usage:
   857→    python scripts/download_youtube.py              # Process all pending
   858→    python scripts/download_youtube.py --video-id X # Single video (no delay)
   859→
   860→Environment variables:
   861→    ADMIN_API_KEY          - API key for admin endpoints
   862→    API_BASE_URL           - Base URL (default: https://api.bhavanaai.com)
   863→    BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING - Azure Blob connection string
   864→    YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH   - Path to cookies.txt file
   865→"""
   866→
   867→import argparse
   868→import os
   869→import random
   870→import sys
   871→import tempfile
   872→import time
   873→from pathlib import Path
   874→
   875→import requests
   876→import yt_dlp
   877→from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient
   878→from dotenv import load_dotenv
   879→
   880→load_dotenv()
   881→
   882→# Configuration
   883→API_BASE_URL = os.getenv("API_BASE_URL", "https://api.bhavanaai.com")
   884→ADMIN_API_KEY = os.getenv("ADMIN_API_KEY")
   885→BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING = os.getenv("BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING")
   886→YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH = os.getenv("YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH")
   887→CONTAINER_NAME = "audio-staging"
   888→
   889→# Rate limiting
   890→MIN_DELAY_SECONDS = 60
   891→MAX_DELAY_SECONDS = 120
   892→JITTER_SECONDS = 30
   893→
   894→
   895→def get_delay() -> float:
   896→    """Calculate delay with jitter."""
   897→    base = random.uniform(MIN_DELAY_SECONDS, MAX_DELAY_SECONDS)
   898→    jitter = random.uniform(-JITTER_SECONDS, JITTER_SECONDS)
   899→    return max(30, base + jitter)
   900→
   901→
   902→def get_pending_episodes() -> list[dict]:
   903→    """Fetch pending YouTube episodes from API."""
   904→    response = requests.get(
   905→        f"{API_BASE_URL}/admin/youtube/pending",
   906→        headers={"X-Admin-Key": ADMIN_API_KEY},
   907→        timeout=30,
   908→    )
   909→    response.raise_for_status()
   910→    return response.json()["episodes"]
   911→
   912→
   913→def download_audio(video_id: str, output_dir: Path) -> Path:
   914→    """Download audio from YouTube using yt-dlp."""
   915→    url = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}"
   916→    output_path = output_dir / f"{video_id}.mp3"
   917→
   918→    ydl_opts = {
   919→        "format": "bestaudio/best",
   920→        "outtmpl": str(output_dir / f"{video_id}.%(ext)s"),
   921→        "postprocessors": [
   922→            {
   923→                "key": "FFmpegExtractAudio",
   924→                "preferredcodec": "mp3",
   925→                "preferredquality": "192",
   926→            }
   927→        ],
   928→        "quiet": True,
   929→    }
   930→
   931→    if YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH:
   932→        ydl_opts["cookiefile"] = YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH
   933→
   934→    with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(ydl_opts) as ydl:
   935→        ydl.download([url])
   936→
   937→    return output_path
   938→
   939→
   940→def upload_to_blob(local_path: Path, episode_id: str) -> str:
   941→    """Upload audio file to Azure Blob Storage."""
   942→    blob_name = f"audio-staging/{episode_id}.mp3"
   943→
   944→    blob_service = BlobServiceClient.from_connection_string(BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING)
   945→    blob_client = blob_service.get_blob_client(CONTAINER_NAME, f"{episode_id}.mp3")
   946→
   947→    with open(local_path, "rb") as f:
   948→        blob_client.upload_blob(f, overwrite=True)
   949→
   950→    return blob_name
   951→
   952→
   953→def mark_audio_uploaded(episode_id: str, blob_path: str) -> None:
   954→    """Mark episode as having audio uploaded."""
   955→    response = requests.post(
   956→        f"{API_BASE_URL}/admin/youtube/audio-uploaded",
   957→        headers={"X-Admin-Key": ADMIN_API_KEY},
   958→        json={"episode_id": episode_id, "blob_path": blob_path},
   959→        timeout=30,
   960→    )
   961→    response.raise_for_status()
   962→
   963→
   964→def process_episode(episode: dict, temp_dir: Path) -> bool:
   965→    """Process a single episode. Returns True on success."""
   966→    video_id = episode["youtube_video_id"]
   967→    episode_id = episode["episode_id"]
   968→    title = episode.get("title", "Unknown")
   969→
   970→    print(f"Processing: {title} ({video_id})")
   971→
   972→    try:
   973→        # Download
   974→        print("  Downloading audio...")
   975→        audio_path = download_audio(video_id, temp_dir)
   976→
   977→        # Upload
   978→        print("  Uploading to blob...")
   979→        blob_path = upload_to_blob(audio_path, episode_id)
   980→
   981→        # Mark complete
   982→        print("  Marking complete...")
   983→        mark_audio_uploaded(episode_id, blob_path)
   984→
   985→        # Cleanup
   986→        audio_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   987→
   988→        print("  Done!")
   989→        return True
   990→
   991→    except Exception as e:
   992→        print(f"  FAILED: {e}")
   993→        return False
   994→
   995→
   996→def main():
   997→    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Download YouTube audio locally")
   998→    parser.add_argument("--video-id", help="Process single video ID")
   999→    parser.add_argument("--no-delay", action="store_true", help="Skip rate limiting")
  1000→    args = parser.parse_args()
  1001→
  1002→    # Validate config
  1003→    if not ADMIN_API_KEY:
  1004→        print("ERROR: ADMIN_API_KEY not set")
  1005→        sys.exit(1)
  1006→    if not BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING:
  1007→        print("ERROR: BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING not set")
  1008→        sys.exit(1)
  1009→
  1010→    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
  1011→        temp_path = Path(temp_dir)
  1012→
  1013→        if args.video_id:
  1014→            # Single video mode
  1015→            episode = {
  1016→                "youtube_video_id": args.video_id,
  1017→                "episode_id": args.video_id,  # Placeholder
  1018→                "title": f"Video {args.video_id}",
  1019→            }
  1020→            process_episode(episode, temp_path)
  1021→        else:
  1022→            # Batch mode
  1023→            print("Fetching pending episodes...")
  1024→            episodes = get_pending_episodes()
  1025→            print(f"Found {len(episodes)} pending episodes\n")
  1026→
  1027→            success = 0
  1028→            failed = 0
  1029→
  1030→            for i, episode in enumerate(episodes):
  1031→                if process_episode(episode, temp_path):
  1032→                    success += 1
  1033→                else:
  1034→                    failed += 1
  1035→
  1036→                # Rate limit between downloads
  1037→                if not args.no_delay and i < len(episodes) - 1:
  1038→                    delay = get_delay()
  1039→                    print(f"\nWaiting {delay:.0f}s before next download...\n")
  1040→                    time.sleep(delay)
  1041→
  1042→            print(f"\n{'='*40}")
  1043→            print(f"Complete: {success} succeeded, {failed} failed")
  1044→

```python
"""Admin YouTube management endpoints."""

from fastapi import APIRouter
from sqlalchemy import func, select

from src.api.admin.schemas import PendingYouTubeEpisode, PendingYouTubeResponse
from src.api.dependencies import AdminUser, DbSession
from src.db.models import Channel, Delivery, Episode

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/pending", response_model=PendingYouTubeResponse)
def get_pending_youtube_episodes(
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> PendingYouTubeResponse:
    """Get YouTube episodes that need manual audio download."""
    # Query episodes with pending deliveries, no audio uploaded
    query = (
        select(
            Episode.episode_id,
            Episode.youtube_video_id,
            Episode.title,
            Episode.published_at,
            Channel.name.label("channel_name"),
            func.count(Delivery.delivery_id).label("pending_deliveries"),
        )
        .join(Channel, Episode.channel_id == Channel.channel_id)
        .join(Delivery, Episode.episode_id == Delivery.episode_id)
        .where(
            Episode.source_type == "youtube",
            Episode.audio_blob_path.is_(None),
            Delivery.status == "pending",
        )
        .group_by(
            Episode.episode_id,
            Episode.youtube_video_id,
            Episode.title,
            Episode.published_at,
            Channel.name,
        )
        .order_by(Episode.published_at.asc())  # Oldest first
    )

    results = db.execute(query).all()

    episodes = [
        PendingYouTubeEpisode(
            episode_id=row.episode_id,
            youtube_video_id=row.youtube_video_id,
            title=row.title,
            channel_name=row.channel_name,
            published_at=row.published_at,
            pending_deliveries=row.pending_deliveries,
        )
        for row in results
    ]

    return PendingYouTubeResponse(episodes=episodes, count=len(episodes))
```

```python
"""Admin authentication utilities."""

from fastapi import Header, HTTPException

from src.config import settings


def verify_admin_api_key(
    x_admin_key: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-Admin-Key"),
) -> bool:
    """Verify admin API key from header.

    Returns True if valid API key provided.
    Raises 401 if invalid.
    Returns False if no key provided (fall through to session auth).
    """
    if x_admin_key is None:
        return False

    if not settings.admin_api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=401,
            detail="Admin API key not configured",
        )

    if x_admin_key != settings.admin_api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=401,
            detail="Invalid admin API key",
        )

    return True
```

```python
    """Episode should be skipped (not failed, just not ready)."""

def _get_audio_for_episode(self, episode: Episode, temp_dir: Path) -> Path:
    """Resolve audio source for an episode.

    Priority:
    1. Uploaded audio in blob storage (audio_blob_path)
    2. RSS audio URL (download from source)
    3. YouTube without upload -> skip

    Returns:
        Path to local audio file.

    Raises:
        SkipEpisodeError: YouTube episode needs manual audio upload.
        ProcessingError: No audio source available.
    """
    # Option 1: Audio already uploaded to blob
    if episode.audio_blob_path:
        logger.info(f"Using uploaded audio: {episode.audio_blob_path}")
        local_path = temp_dir / f"{episode.episode_id}.mp3"
        return self.blob.download_to_file(episode.audio_blob_path, local_path)

    # Option 2: RSS podcast - download from source URL
    if episode.source_type == "rss" and episode.audio_url:
        logger.info(f"Downloading RSS audio from: {episode.audio_url}")
        return download_audio_from_url(episode.audio_url, temp_dir)

    # Option 3: YouTube without uploaded audio - skip
    if episode.source_type == "youtube":
        raise SkipEpisodeError(
            f"YouTube episode {episode.youtube_video_id} needs manual audio upload"
        )

    raise ProcessingError(f"No audio source for episode {episode.episode_id}")
```

## Task 6: Create Local Download Script

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/download_youtube.py`

**Step 1: Create the script**

Create `scripts/download_youtube.py`:
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Download YouTube audio locally and upload to Azure Blob Storage.

Usage:
    python scripts/download_youtube.py              # Process all pending
    python scripts/download_youtube.py --video-id X # Single video (no delay)

Environment variables:
    ADMIN_API_KEY          - API key for admin endpoints
    API_BASE_URL           - Base URL (default: https://api.bhavanaai.com)
    BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING - Azure Blob connection string
    YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH   - Path to cookies.txt file
"""

import argparse
import os
import random
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

import requests
import yt_dlp
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

# Configuration
API_BASE_URL = os.getenv("API_BASE_URL", "https://api.bhavanaai.com")
ADMIN_API_KEY = os.getenv("ADMIN_API_KEY")
BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING = os.getenv("BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING")
YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH = os.getenv("YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH")
CONTAINER_NAME = "audio-staging"

# Rate limiting
MIN_DELAY_SECONDS = 60
MAX_DELAY_SECONDS = 120
JITTER_SECONDS = 30


def get_delay() -> float:
    """Calculate delay with jitter."""
    base = random.uniform(MIN_DELAY_SECONDS, MAX_DELAY_SECONDS)
    jitter = random.uniform(-JITTER_SECONDS, JITTER_SECONDS)
    return max(30, base + jitter)


def get_pending_episodes() -> list[dict]:
    """Fetch pending YouTube episodes from API."""
    response = requests.get(
        f"{API_BASE_URL}/admin/youtube/pending",
        headers={"X-Admin-Key": ADMIN_API_KEY},
        timeout=30,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["episodes"]


def download_audio(video_id: str, output_dir: Path) -> Path:
    """Download audio from YouTube using yt-dlp."""
    url = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}"
    output_path = output_dir / f"{video_id}.mp3"

    ydl_opts = {
        "format": "bestaudio/best",
        "outtmpl": str(output_dir / f"{video_id}.%(ext)s"),
        "postprocessors": [
            {
                "key": "FFmpegExtractAudio",
                "preferredcodec": "mp3",
                "preferredquality": "192",
            }
        ],
        "quiet": True,
    }

    if YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH:
        ydl_opts["cookiefile"] = YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH

    with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(ydl_opts) as ydl:
        ydl.download([url])

    return output_path


def upload_to_blob(local_path: Path, episode_id: str) -> str:
    """Upload audio file to Azure Blob Storage."""
    blob_name = f"audio-staging/{episode_id}.mp3"

    blob_service = BlobServiceClient.from_connection_string(BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING)
    blob_client = blob_service.get_blob_client(CONTAINER_NAME, f"{episode_id}.mp3")

    with open(local_path, "rb") as f:
        blob_client.upload_blob(f, overwrite=True)

    return blob_name


def mark_audio_uploaded(episode_id: str, blob_path: str) -> None:
    """Mark episode as having audio uploaded."""
    response = requests.post(
        f"{API_BASE_URL}/admin/youtube/audio-uploaded",
        headers={"X-Admin-Key": ADMIN_API_KEY},
        json={"episode_id": episode_id, "blob_path": blob_path},
        timeout=30,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()


def process_episode(episode: dict, temp_dir: Path) -> bool:
    """Process a single episode. Returns True on success."""
    video_id = episode["youtube_video_id"]
    episode_id = episode["episode_id"]
    title = episode.get("title", "Unknown")

    print(f"Processing: {title} ({video_id})")

    try:
        # Download
        print("  Downloading audio...")
        audio_path = download_audio(video_id, temp_dir)

        # Upload
        print("  Uploading to blob...")
        blob_path = upload_to_blob(audio_path, episode_id)

        # Mark complete
        print("  Marking complete...")
        mark_audio_uploaded(episode_id, blob_path)

        # Cleanup
        audio_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)

        print("  Done!")
        return True

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  FAILED: {e}")
        return False


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Download YouTube audio locally")
    parser.add_argument("--video-id", help="Process single video ID")
    parser.add_argument("--no-delay", action="store_true", help="Skip rate limiting")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Validate config
    if not ADMIN_API_KEY:
        print("ERROR: ADMIN_API_KEY not set")
        sys.exit(1)
    if not BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING:
        print("ERROR: BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING not set")
        sys.exit(1)

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
        temp_path = Path(temp_dir)

        if args.video_id:
            # Single video mode
            episode = {
                "youtube_video_id": args.video_id,
                "episode_id": args.video_id,  # Placeholder
                "title": f"Video {args.video_id}",
            }
            process_episode(episode, temp_path)
        else:
            # Batch mode
            print("Fetching pending episodes...")
            episodes = get_pending_episodes()
            print(f"Found {len(episodes)} pending episodes\n")

            success = 0
            failed = 0

            for i, episode in enumerate(episodes):
                if process_episode(episode, temp_path):
                    success += 1
                else:
                    failed += 1

                # Rate limit between downloads
                if not args.no_delay and i < len(episodes) - 1:
                    delay = get_delay()
                    print(f"\nWaiting {delay:.0f}s before next download...\n")
                    time.sleep(delay)

            print(f"\n{'='*40}")
            print(f"Complete: {success} succeeded, {failed} failed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
"""Admin YouTube management endpoints."""

from fastapi import APIRouter
from sqlalchemy import func, select

from src.api.admin.schemas import PendingYouTubeEpisode, PendingYouTubeResponse
from src.api.dependencies import AdminUser, DbSession
from src.db.models import Channel, Delivery, Episode

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/pending", response_model=PendingYouTubeResponse)
def get_pending_youtube_episodes(
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> PendingYouTubeResponse:
    """Get YouTube episodes that need manual audio download."""
    # Query episodes with pending deliveries, no audio uploaded
    query = (
        select(
            Episode.episode_id,
            Episode.youtube_video_id,
            Episode.title,
            Episode.published_at,
            Channel.name.label("channel_name"),
            func.count(Delivery.delivery_id).label("pending_deliveries"),
        )
        .join(Channel, Episode.channel_id == Channel.channel_id)
        .join(Delivery, Episode.episode_id == Delivery.episode_id)
        .where(
            Episode.source_type == "youtube",
            Episode.audio_blob_path.is_(None),
            Delivery.status == "pending",
        )
        .group_by(
            Episode.episode_id,
            Episode.youtube_video_id,
            Episode.title,
            Episode.published_at,
            Channel.name,
        )
        .order_by(Episode.published_at.asc())  # Oldest first
    )

    results = db.execute(query).all()

    episodes = [
        PendingYouTubeEpisode(
            episode_id=row.episode_id,
            youtube_video_id=row.youtube_video_id,
            title=row.title,
            channel_name=row.channel_name,
            published_at=row.published_at,
            pending_deliveries=row.pending_deliveries,
        )
        for row in results
    ]

    return PendingYouTubeResponse(episodes=episodes, count=len(episodes))
```

```python
       episode_id: UUID
```
   ```python
       blob_path: str = Field(..., pattern=r"^audio-staging/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.(mp3|m4a|wav)$")
   ```

```python
"""Admin authentication utilities."""

from fastapi import Header, HTTPException

from src.config import settings


def verify_admin_api_key(
    x_admin_key: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-Admin-Key"),
) -> bool:
    """Verify admin API key from header.

    Returns True if valid API key provided.
    Raises 401 if invalid.
    Returns False if no key provided (fall through to session auth).
    """
    if x_admin_key is None:
        return False

    if not settings.admin_api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=401,
            detail="Admin API key not configured",
        )

    if x_admin_key != settings.admin_api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=401,
            detail="Invalid admin API key",
        )

    return True
```

# Code Review: Task 4 - API Key Authentication for Admin YouTube Endpoints

## Summary

Task 4 implements X-Admin-Key header authentication as an alternative to session-based authentication for the admin YouTube endpoints. This enables local scripts to call admin endpoints without requiring a browser session.

## Plan Alignment Analysis

### Alignment with Plan

| Planned Item | Implementation Status | Notes |
|--------------|----------------------|-------|
| Add `admin_api_key` config setting | Implemented | Added to `src/config.py` line 86-87 |
| Create `src/api/admin/auth.py` with `verify_admin_api_key` | Implemented | Created as specified |
| Modify youtube.py to accept API key OR session | Implemented | Uses `AdminOrApiKey` dependency |
| Create 3 unit tests | Implemented | All 3 tests passing |

The implementation closely follows the plan with minor beneficial deviations.

### Deviations from Plan (All Beneficial)

1. **Uses `get_settings()` instead of direct `settings` import in `auth.py`**: The plan showed importing `settings` directly, but the implementation uses `get_settings()`. This is **correct** because it ensures proper configuration loading and is consistent with how other modules access settings.

2. **Added `get_optional_user_no_raise` helper**: The implementation adds a helper function in `youtube.py` (lines 23-34) to handle getting the user without raising exceptions. This is a **good addition** because:
   - It properly handles the case where API key auth should fall through to session auth
   - It avoids unnecessary exception handling in the main auth flow
   - It's more explicit about the intended behavior

3. **Test fixture uses `get_settings()` instead of `settings`**: The test file correctly uses `get_settings()` to access the settings instance for monkeypatching, which is more robust.

---

## Code Quality Assessment

### What Was Done Well

1. **Clean separation of concerns**: The API key verification logic is isolated in `src/api/admin/auth.py`, separate from endpoint code.

2. **Proper fallback behavior**: The implementation correctly:
   - Returns `False` if no API key is provided (falls through to session auth)
   - Raises 401 if API key is provided but invalid
   - Raises 401 if API key is provided but not configured on server

3. **Good documentation**: The docstrings clearly explain the return values and error conditions.

4. **Type annotations**: All functions have proper type annotations.

5. **Consistent error handling**: Uses HTTPException with appropriate status codes (401 for auth failures, 403 for authorization).

6. **Tests cover key scenarios**: The three tests cover:
   - Unauthenticated requests are rejected (401)
   - Valid API key is accepted
   - Invalid API key is rejected (401)

### Issues Identified

#### Important (Should Fix)

1. **Linter error - Import ordering in `youtube.py`**

   **File:** `/Users/varunr/projects/podcast-summarizer-v2/src/api/admin/youtube.py`
   
   The imports are not properly sorted according to isort/ruff rules. The error message shows:
   ```
   I001 [*] Import block is un-sorted or un-formatted
   ```
   
   Lines 17-18 have `src.db.session` before `src.db.models` which violates alphabetical ordering:
   ```python
   from src.api.dependencies import DbSession, get_current_user
   from src.db.session import get_db      # Should come after models
   from src.db.models import Channel, Delivery, Episode, User
   ```
   
   **Recommendation:** Run `ruff check --fix src/api/admin/youtube.py` to auto-fix.

2. **Missing test for API key with audio-uploaded endpoint**

   **File:** `/Users/varunr/projects/podcast-summarizer-v2/tests/unit/test_admin_api_key.py`
   
   The tests only verify API key auth works for `GET /admin/youtube/pending`. The `POST /admin/youtube/audio-uploaded` endpoint also uses `AdminOrApiKey` but has no API key tests.
   
   **Recommendation:** Add tests for the POST endpoint:
   ```python
   def test_audio_uploaded_accepts_api_key(self, db_session, monkeypatch):
       """Should accept valid API key for audio-uploaded endpoint."""
       # Similar to pending endpoint test, but POST to /admin/youtube/audio-uploaded
   ```

#### Suggestions (Nice to Have)

1. **Consider constant-time comparison for API key**

   **File:** `/Users/varunr/projects/podcast-summarizer-v2/src/api/admin/auth.py` (line 28)
   
   The current comparison uses `==` which may be vulnerable to timing attacks:
   ```python
   if x_admin_key != settings.admin_api_key:
   ```
   
   While this is an internal admin endpoint and timing attacks are unlikely in practice, using `secrets.compare_digest()` is a security best practice:
   ```python
   import secrets
   if not secrets.compare_digest(x_admin_key, settings.admin_api_key):
   ```

Create `scripts/download_youtube.py`:
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Download YouTube audio locally and upload to Azure Blob Storage.

Usage:
    python scripts/download_youtube.py              # Process all pending
    python scripts/download_youtube.py --video-id X # Single video (no delay)

Environment variables:
    ADMIN_API_KEY          - API key for admin endpoints
    API_BASE_URL           - Base URL (default: https://api.bhavanaai.com)
    BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING - Azure Blob connection string
    YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH   - Path to cookies.txt file (optional)
"""

import argparse
import os
import random
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

import requests
import yt_dlp
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

# Configuration
API_BASE_URL = os.getenv("API_BASE_URL", "https://api.bhavanaai.com")
ADMIN_API_KEY = os.getenv("ADMIN_API_KEY")
BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING = os.getenv("BLOB_CONNECTION_STRING")
YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH = os.getenv("YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH")
CONTAINER_NAME = "audio-staging"

# Rate limiting
MIN_DELAY_SECONDS = 60
MAX_DELAY_SECONDS = 120
JITTER_SECONDS = 30


def get_delay() -> float:
    """Calculate delay with jitter."""
    base = random.uniform(MIN_DELAY_SECONDS, MAX_DELAY_SECONDS)
    jitter = random.uniform(-JITTER_SECONDS, JITTER_SECONDS)
    return max(30, base + jitter)
```

## Task Description

**Goal:** Add the admin API key as a secret in Azure Key Vault so the API service can read it.

**Step 1: Add parameter**

```bicep
@secure()
@description('Admin API key for local scripts')
param adminApiKey string = ''
```

**Step 2: Add secret to Key Vault**

Find the Key Vault secrets section and add a new secret resource:
```bicep
resource adminApiKeySecret 'Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/secrets@2023-07-01' = if (!empty(adminApiKey)) {
  parent: keyVault
  name: 'admin-api-key'
  properties: {
    value: adminApiKey
  }
}
```

**Step 3: Reference in Container App environment**

Find where environment variables are set for the API service container app. Add the admin API key env var:
```bicep
{
  name: 'ADMIN_API_KEY'
  secretRef: 'admin-api-key'
}
```

```bicep
{
  name: 'admin-api-key'
  keyVaultUrl: '${keyVault.properties.vaultUri}secrets/admin-api-key'
  identity: managedIdentity.id
}
```

```bash
git add infra/main.bicep
```

import os
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text

db_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(db_url)

with engine.connect() as conn:
    # Find Dwarkesh episodes with pending deliveries and check transcript status
    query = text("""
        SELECT 
            e.episode_id,
            e.youtube_video_id,
            e.title,
            e.audio_blob_path,
            tk.transcript_id as has_transcript
        FROM episodes e
        JOIN channels c ON e.channel_id = c.channel_id
        LEFT JOIN transcript_keys tk ON tk.key_value = e.youtube_video_id AND tk.key_type = 'youtube_video_id'
        WHERE c.name LIKE '%Dwarkesh%'
        AND e.source_type = 'youtube'
        ORDER BY e.published_at DESC
    """)
    
    results = conn.execute(query).fetchall()
    
    with_transcript = [r for r in results if r.has_transcript]
    without_transcript = [r for r in results if not r.has_transcript]
    
    print(f"=== Dwarkesh Podcast Episodes ===")

    """Normalize title for comparison."""
    if not title:
        return ""
    # Remove common prefixes, lowercase, remove punctuation
    t = title.lower()
    t = re.sub(r'^(dwarkesh podcast[:\s\-–]*|the\s+)', '', t)
    t = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', t)

        SELECT episode_id, youtube_video_id, title, audio_blob_path
        FROM episodes e
        JOIN channels c ON e.channel_id = c.channel_id
        WHERE c.channel_id = '67478CA7-CAE8-4328-8B85-4EC7FBD916DB'
        ORDER BY published_at DESC

import os
import re
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text

db_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")

YT_CHANNEL_ID = '77A60AC2-793A-4EDD-B331-BEDA0E718229'
RSS_CHANNEL_ID = 'ADCFB99A-61F6-4C34-9C28-B9C0CCCCD705'

def normalize_title(title):
    """Normalize title for matching."""
    if not title:
        return ""
    t = title.lower()
    # Remove common patterns
    t = re.sub(r'^(dwarkesh podcast[:\s\-–]*)', '', t)
    t = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', ' ', t)
    t = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', t).strip()
    return t

def extract_guest(title):
    """Extract guest name from title."""
    if not title:
        return None
    # Pattern: "Guest Name — Topic" or "Guest Name – Topic" 
    m = re.search(r'^([A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)?)\s*[—–\-]', title)
    if m:
        return m.group(1).lower()
    return None

with engine.connect() as conn:
    # Get YouTube episodes
    yt_eps = conn.execute(text("""
        SELECT episode_id, youtube_video_id, title
        FROM episodes WHERE channel_id = :cid
    """), {"cid": YT_CHANNEL_ID}).fetchall()
    
    # Get RSS episodes with transcripts
    rss_eps = conn.execute(text("""
        SELECT e.episode_id, e.title, e.audio_url, tk.transcript_id
        FROM episodes e
        LEFT JOIN transcript_keys tk ON tk.key_value = e.audio_url AND tk.key_type = 'audio_url'
        WHERE e.channel_id = :cid
    """), {"cid": RSS_CHANNEL_ID}).fetchall()
    
    print(f"YouTube episodes: {len(yt_eps)}")
    print(f"RSS episodes: {len(rss_eps)}")
    
    # Build RSS lookup by normalized title and guest
    rss_by_title = {}
    rss_by_guest = {}
    for r in rss_eps:
        norm = normalize_title(r.title)
        guest = extract_guest(r.title)
        if norm:
            rss_by_title[norm] = r
        if guest and r.transcript_id:
            if guest not in rss_by_guest:
                rss_by_guest[guest] = []
            rss_by_guest[guest].append(r)
    
    # Match and link transcripts
    matched = 0
    linked = 0
    
    for yt in yt_eps:
        yt_norm = normalize_title(yt.title)
        yt_guest = extract_guest(yt.title)
        
        # Try exact-ish title match first
        match = None
        for rss_norm, rss in rss_by_title.items():
            # Check if key parts match
            if len(yt_norm) > 10 and len(rss_norm) > 10:
                if yt_norm[:30] in rss_norm or rss_norm[:30] in yt_norm:
                    match = rss
                    break
        
        # Try guest match if no title match
        if not match and yt_guest and yt_guest in rss_by_guest:
            # Get the RSS episode with transcript for this guest
            for rss in rss_by_guest[yt_guest]:
                match = rss
                break
        
        if match and match.transcript_id:
            matched += 1
            # Check if already linked
            existing = conn.execute(text("""
                SELECT 1 FROM transcript_keys 
                WHERE key_type = 'youtube_video_id' AND key_value = :vid
            """), {"vid": yt.youtube_video_id}).fetchone()
            
            if not existing:
                # Link the YouTube video to the transcript
                conn.execute(text("""
                    INSERT INTO transcript_keys (key_type, key_value, transcript_id)
                    VALUES ('youtube_video_id', :vid, :tid)
                """), {"vid": yt.youtube_video_id, "tid": match.transcript_id})
                linked += 1
    
    conn.commit()
    
    print(f"\n=== Matching Results ===")
    print(f"Matched to RSS with transcript: {matched}")
    print(f"Newly linked: {linked}")
    print(f"Still need download: {len(yt_eps) - matched}")
    
    # Show some unmatched for verification
    print(f"\n=== Sample Unmatched (need download) ===")
    unmatched_count = 0
    for yt in yt_eps:
        yt_guest = extract_guest(yt.title)
        if not yt_guest or yt_guest not in rss_by_guest:
            print(f"  {yt.youtube_video_id}: {yt.title[:55]}...")
            unmatched_count += 1
            if unmatched_count >= 10:
                break
EOF

@router.get("/pending", response_model=PendingYouTubeResponse)
def get_pending_youtube_episodes(
    admin: AdminOrApiKey,
    db: DbSession,
) -> PendingYouTubeResponse:

    - Have source_type='youtube'
    - Have no audio_blob_path (audio not yet uploaded)

        select(
            Episode.episode_id,

            Episode.audio_blob_path.is_(None),

            Episode.youtube_video_id,
            Episode.title,
            Episode.published_at,
            Channel.name,

"""Admin YouTube management endpoints."""

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Cookie, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.api.admin.auth import verify_admin_api_key
from src.api.admin.schemas import (
    MarkAudioUploadedRequest,
    MarkAudioUploadedResponse,
    PendingYouTubeEpisode,
    PendingYouTubeResponse,
)
from src.api.dependencies import DbSession, get_current_user
from src.db.models import Channel, Delivery, Episode, TranscriptKey, User
from src.db.session import get_db

router = APIRouter()


async def get_optional_user_no_raise(
    db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)],
    session_token: Annotated[str | None, Cookie()] = None,
) -> User | None:
    """Get current user if authenticated, None otherwise (no exception)."""
    if not session_token:
        return None

    try:
        return await get_current_user(db, session_token)
    except HTTPException:
        return None


async def get_admin_user_or_api_key(
    api_key_valid: Annotated[bool, Depends(verify_admin_api_key)],
    db: DbSession,
    user: Annotated[User | None, Depends(get_optional_user_no_raise)],
) -> User | None:
    """Get admin user from session or validate API key."""
    if api_key_valid:
        return None  # API key auth, no user needed

    if user is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Authentication required")

    if not user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Admin access required")

    return user


AdminOrApiKey = Annotated[User | None, Depends(get_admin_user_or_api_key)]


@router.get("/pending", response_model=PendingYouTubeResponse)
def get_pending_youtube_episodes(
    admin: AdminOrApiKey,
    db: DbSession,
) -> PendingYouTubeResponse:
    """Get YouTube episodes that need manual audio download.

    Returns YouTube episodes that:
    - Have source_type='youtube'
    - Have no audio_blob_path (audio not yet uploaded)
    - Have at least one pending delivery

    Results are ordered by published_at ascending (oldest first).
    """
    # Query episodes with pending deliveries, no audio uploaded
    query = (
        select(
            Episode.episode_id,
            Episode.youtube_video_id,
            Episode.title,
            Episode.published_at,
            Channel.name.label("channel_name"),
            func.count(Delivery.delivery_id).label("pending_deliveries"),
        )
        .join(Channel, Episode.channel_id == Channel.channel_id)
        .join(Delivery, Episode.episode_id == Delivery.episode_id)
        .where(
            Episode.source_type == "youtube",
            Episode.audio_blob_path.is_(None),
            Delivery.status == "pending",
        )
        .group_by(
            Episode.episode_id,
            Episode.youtube_video_id,
            Episode.title,
            Episode.published_at,
            Channel.name,
        )
        .order_by(Episode.published_at.asc())  # Oldest first
    )

    results = db.execute(query).all()

    episodes = [
        PendingYouTubeEpisode(
            episode_id=row.episode_id,
            youtube_video_id=row.youtube_video_id,
            title=row.title,
            channel_name=row.channel_name,
            published_at=row.published_at,
            pending_deliveries=row.pending_deliveries,
        )
        for row in results
    ]

    return PendingYouTubeResponse(episodes=episodes, count=len(episodes))


@router.post("/audio-uploaded", response_model=MarkAudioUploadedResponse)
def mark_audio_uploaded(
    request: MarkAudioUploadedRequest,
    admin: AdminOrApiKey,
    db: DbSession,
) -> MarkAudioUploadedResponse:
    """Mark a YouTube episode as having audio uploaded."""
    episode = db.execute(
        select(Episode).where(Episode.episode_id == request.episode_id)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()

    if not episode:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Episode not found")

    episode.audio_blob_path = request.blob_path
    db.commit()

    return MarkAudioUploadedResponse(
        success=True,
        episode_id=episode.episode_id,
    )

gh issue create --title "Feature: Tier-based LLM model selection for summaries" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary

Enable different LLM models for summary generation based on user subscription tier. Premium users get access to higher-quality models while free tier users get cost-effective alternatives.

## Motivation

- **Cost optimization**: Use expensive models only for paying customers
- **Value differentiation**: Premium tiers get noticeably better summaries
- **Scalability**: Can offer free tier without unsustainable LLM costs

## Proposed Tier Model Mapping

| Tier | Model | Rationale |
|------|-------|-----------|
| Premium | Claude Opus 4.5 | Highest quality summaries |
| Standard | Claude Sonnet 4 | Good balance of quality/cost |
| Free | GPT-4o mini | Cost-effective, acceptable quality |

## Implementation Considerations

1. **User tier lookup**: Already have `user_tiers` table with tier info
2. **Model selection in processor**: Pass tier to LLM provider, select model accordingly
3. **Fallback behavior**: If premium model fails, fall back to standard (not free tier model)
4. **Summary metadata**: Store which model generated the summary for analytics
5. **A/B testing**: May want to test quality perception across tiers

## Open Questions

- Should cached summaries be shared across tiers, or regenerate per-tier?
- How to handle tier changes mid-delivery (user upgrades/downgrades)?
- Should we expose model choice in the email ("Summary generated with Claude Opus 4.5")?

## Related

- Current implementation uses Claude Opus 4.5 for all users with GPT fallback
- Tier system already exists for usage limits
EOF
)"

from src.config import get_settings
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text

settings = get_settings()
engine = create_engine(settings.database_url)

with engine.connect() as conn:
    # Get all channels with episode counts and transcript status
    channels = conn.execute(text("""
        SELECT 
            c.channel_id,
            c.name,
            c.type,
            COUNT(DISTINCT e.episode_id) as total_episodes,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
                WHEN tk.key_value IS NOT NULL THEN e.episode_id 
            END) as episodes_with_transcripts
        FROM channels c
        LEFT JOIN episodes e ON c.channel_id = e.channel_id
        LEFT JOIN transcript_keys tk ON (
            (tk.key_type = 'youtube_video_id' AND tk.key_value = e.youtube_video_id)
            OR (tk.key_type = 'audio_url' AND tk.key_value = e.audio_url)
        )
        GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.name, c.type
        ORDER BY total_episodes DESC
    """)).fetchall()
    
    print("=== Channels Overview ===")
    print(f"{'Channel':<40} {'Type':<8} {'Episodes':<10} {'Transcribed':<12} {'Gap'}")

    print(f"\n=== Transcript Stats ===")

"""Admin channel management endpoints."""

from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy import func, select

from src.api.admin.schemas import (
    AdminChannelCreate,
    AdminChannelDetail,
    AdminChannelSummary,
    AdminChannelUpdate,
    PaginatedResponse,
)
from src.api.dependencies import AdminUser, DbSession
from src.db.models import Channel, Episode, Subscription, Summary, TranscriptKey

router = APIRouter()


def _get_channel_or_404(db: DbSession, channel_id: UUID) -> Channel:
    """Get a channel by ID or raise 404."""
    channel = db.execute(select(Channel).where(Channel.channel_id == channel_id)).scalar()
    if not channel:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Channel not found")
    return channel


def _build_channel_detail(db: DbSession, channel: Channel) -> AdminChannelDetail:
    """Build AdminChannelDetail from a Channel model."""
    # Combine all counts into a single query
    stats = db.execute(
        select(
            func.coalesce(
                select(func.count())
                .where(Subscription.channel_id == channel.channel_id)
                .correlate(None)
                .scalar_subquery(),
                0,
            ).label("subscriber_count"),
            func.coalesce(
                select(func.count())
                .where(Episode.channel_id == channel.channel_id)
                .correlate(None)
                .scalar_subquery(),
                0,
            ).label("episode_count"),
            select(func.max(Episode.published_at))
            .where(Episode.channel_id == channel.channel_id)
            .correlate(None)
            .scalar_subquery()
            .label("last_episode_at"),
        )
    ).one()

    return AdminChannelDetail(
        channel_id=channel.channel_id,
        name=channel.name,
        type=channel.type,
        category=channel.category,
        description=channel.description,
        youtube_channel_id=channel.youtube_channel_id,
        youtube_playlist_id=channel.youtube_playlist_id,
        rss_feed_url=channel.rss_feed_url,
        is_active=channel.is_active,
        subscriber_count=stats.subscriber_count,
        episode_count=stats.episode_count,
        last_episode_at=stats.last_episode_at,
        created_at=channel.created_at,
    )


@router.get("", response_model=PaginatedResponse)
def list_channels(
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    search: str | None = None,
    type: str | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by channel type"),

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status

from src.api.admin.schemas import (
    AdminDeliveryStats,

)
from src.api.dependencies import AdminUser, DbSession
from src.db.models import Delivery, Episode, Summary, TranscriptKey

router = APIRouter()


def _get_episode_or_404(db: DbSession, episode_id: UUID) -> Episode:
    """Get an episode by ID or raise 404."""
    episode = db.execute(select(Episode).where(Episode.episode_id == episode_id)).scalar()
    if not episode:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Episode not found")
    return episode


@router.get("", response_model=PaginatedResponse)
def list_episodes(
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    search: str | None = Query(default=None, description="Search by episode title"),
    channel_id: UUID | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by channel ID"),  # noqa: B008
    has_transcript: bool | None = Query(
        default=None, description="Filter by transcript availability"
    ),
    has_summary: bool | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by summary availability"),
) -> PaginatedResponse:
    """List episodes with pagination and filters."""
    # Build filter conditions (reused for both count and main query)
    filters: list[Any] = []
    if search:
        filters.append(Episode.title.ilike(f"%{search}%"))
    if channel_id:
        filters.append(Episode.channel_id == channel_id)

    # Transcript filter subquery
    transcript_subquery = (
        select(TranscriptKey.key_value)
        .where(TranscriptKey.key_type == "youtube_video_id")
        .scalar_subquery()
    )
    if has_transcript is True:
        filters.append(Episode.youtube_video_id.in_(transcript_subquery))
    elif has_transcript is False:
        filters.append(
            Episode.youtube_video_id.not_in(transcript_subquery)
            | Episode.youtube_video_id.is_(None)
        )

    # Summary filter subquery
    summary_subquery = select(Summary.episode_id).distinct().scalar_subquery()
    if has_summary is True:
        filters.append(Episode.episode_id.in_(summary_subquery))
    elif has_summary is False:
        filters.append(Episode.episode_id.not_in(summary_subquery))

    # Get total count
    count_query = select(func.count()).select_from(Episode)
    if filters:
        count_query = count_query.where(*filters)
    total = db.execute(count_query).scalar() or 0

    # Subqueries for transcript/summary flags using LEFT OUTER JOIN
    # (SQL Server compatible - avoids IN in SELECT clause)
    transcript_exists_subq = (
        select(TranscriptKey.key_value.label("video_id"))
        .where(TranscriptKey.key_type == "youtube_video_id")
        .distinct()
        .subquery()
    )
    summary_exists_subq = select(Summary.episode_id.label("ep_id")).distinct().subquery()

    # Main query with flags computed via LEFT OUTER JOINs
    query = (
        select(
            Episode,
            # If join matched, the value is not null = has transcript
            case(
                (transcript_exists_subq.c.video_id.isnot(None), True),
                else_=False,
            ).label("has_transcript"),
            case(
                (summary_exists_subq.c.ep_id.isnot(None), True),
                else_=False,
            ).label("has_summary"),
        )
        .outerjoin(
            transcript_exists_subq,
            Episode.youtube_video_id == transcript_exists_subq.c.video_id,
        )
        .outerjoin(
            summary_exists_subq,
            Episode.episode_id == summary_exists_subq.c.ep_id,
        )
        .options(joinedload(Episode.channel))
    )

    if filters:
        query = query.where(*filters)

    # Order and paginate
    query = query.order_by(
        case((Episode.published_at.is_(None), 1), else_=0),
        Episode.published_at.desc(),
    )
    query = query.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)

    results = db.execute(query).unique().all()

    # Build response
    items = [
        AdminEpisodeSummary(
            episode_id=row.Episode.episode_id,
            title=row.Episode.title,
            channel_name=row.Episode.channel.name if row.Episode.channel else "Unknown",
            source_type=row.Episode.source_type,
            published_at=row.Episode.published_at,
            has_transcript=row.has_transcript,
            has_summary=row.has_summary,
            created_at=row.Episode.created_at,
        )
        for row in results
    ]

    pages = (total + page_size - 1) // page_size if total > 0 else 0

    return PaginatedResponse(
        items=[item.model_dump() for item in items],
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        pages=pages,
    )

"""Admin episode management endpoints."""

from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy import and_, case, func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import joinedload

from src.api.admin.schemas import (
    AdminDeliveryStats,
    AdminEpisodeDetail,
    AdminEpisodeSummary,
    AdminReprocessRequest,
    AdminSummaryInfo,
    AdminTranscriptInfo,
    PaginatedResponse,
)
from src.api.dependencies import AdminUser, DbSession
from src.db.models import Delivery, Episode, Summary, TranscriptKey

router = APIRouter()


def _get_episode_or_404(db: DbSession, episode_id: UUID) -> Episode:
    """Get an episode by ID or raise 404."""
    episode = db.execute(select(Episode).where(Episode.episode_id == episode_id)).scalar()
    if not episode:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Episode not found")
    return episode


@router.get("", response_model=PaginatedResponse)
def list_episodes(
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    search: str | None = Query(default=None, description="Search by episode title"),
    channel_id: UUID | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by channel ID"),  # noqa: B008
    has_transcript: bool | None = Query(
        default=None, description="Filter by transcript availability"
    ),
    has_summary: bool | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by summary availability"),
) -> PaginatedResponse:
    """List episodes with pagination and filters."""
    # Build filter conditions (reused for both count and main query)
    filters: list[Any] = []
    if search:
        filters.append(Episode.title.ilike(f"%{search}%"))
    if channel_id:
        filters.append(Episode.channel_id == channel_id)

    # Transcript filter: check both youtube_video_id and audio_url keys
    yt_transcript_subq = (
        select(TranscriptKey.key_value)
        .where(TranscriptKey.key_type == "youtube_video_id")
        .scalar_subquery()
    )
    audio_transcript_subq = (
        select(TranscriptKey.key_value)
        .where(TranscriptKey.key_type == "audio_url")
        .scalar_subquery()
    )
    if has_transcript is True:
        filters.append(
            or_(
                Episode.youtube_video_id.in_(yt_transcript_subq),
                Episode.audio_url.in_(audio_transcript_subq),
            )
        )
    elif has_transcript is False:
        # No transcript means not in youtube_video_id keys AND not in audio_url keys
        filters.append(
            and_(
                or_(
                    Episode.youtube_video_id.not_in(yt_transcript_subq),
                    Episode.youtube_video_id.is_(None),
                ),
                or_(
                    Episode.audio_url.not_in(audio_transcript_subq),
                    Episode.audio_url.is_(None),
                ),
            )
        )

    # Summary filter subquery
    summary_subquery = select(Summary.episode_id).distinct().scalar_subquery()
    if has_summary is True:
        filters.append(Episode.episode_id.in_(summary_subquery))
    elif has_summary is False:
        filters.append(Episode.episode_id.not_in(summary_subquery))

    # Get total count
    count_query = select(func.count()).select_from(Episode)
    if filters:
        count_query = count_query.where(*filters)
    total = db.execute(count_query).scalar() or 0

    # Subqueries for transcript/summary flags using LEFT OUTER JOIN
    # (SQL Server compatible - avoids IN in SELECT clause)
    transcript_exists_subq = (
        select(TranscriptKey.key_value.label("video_id"))
        .where(TranscriptKey.key_type == "youtube_video_id")
        .distinct()
        .subquery()
    )
    summary_exists_subq = select(Summary.episode_id.label("ep_id")).distinct().subquery()

    # Main query with flags computed via LEFT OUTER JOINs
    query = (
        select(
            Episode,
            # If join matched, the value is not null = has transcript
            case(
                (transcript_exists_subq.c.video_id.isnot(None), True),
                else_=False,
            ).label("has_transcript"),
            case(
                (summary_exists_subq.c.ep_id.isnot(None), True),
                else_=False,
            ).label("has_summary"),
        )
        .outerjoin(
            transcript_exists_subq,
            Episode.youtube_video_id == transcript_exists_subq.c.video_id,
        )
        .outerjoin(
            summary_exists_subq,
            Episode.episode_id == summary_exists_subq.c.ep_id,
        )
        .options(joinedload(Episode.channel))
    )

    if filters:
        query = query.where(*filters)

    # Order and paginate
    query = query.order_by(
        case((Episode.published_at.is_(None), 1), else_=0),
        Episode.published_at.desc(),
    )
    query = query.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)

    results = db.execute(query).unique().all()

    # Build response
    items = [
        AdminEpisodeSummary(
            episode_id=row.Episode.episode_id,
            title=row.Episode.title,
            channel_name=row.Episode.channel.name if row.Episode.channel else "Unknown",
            source_type=row.Episode.source_type,
            published_at=row.Episode.published_at,
            has_transcript=row.has_transcript,
            has_summary=row.has_summary,
            created_at=row.Episode.created_at,
        )
        for row in results
    ]

    pages = (total + page_size - 1) // page_size if total > 0 else 0

    return PaginatedResponse(
        items=[item.model_dump() for item in items],
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        pages=pages,
    )


@router.get("/{episode_id}", response_model=AdminEpisodeDetail)
def get_episode(
    episode_id: UUID,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> AdminEpisodeDetail:
    """Get episode details with transcript info, summary info, and delivery stats."""
    # Load episode with channel
    episode = db.execute(
        select(Episode).options(joinedload(Episode.channel)).where(Episode.episode_id == episode_id)
    ).scalar()

    if not episode:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Episode not found")

    channel = episode.channel

    # Get transcript info via youtube_video_id
    transcript_info = None
    if episode.youtube_video_id:
        transcript_key = db.execute(
            select(TranscriptKey)
            .options(joinedload(TranscriptKey.transcript))
            .where(
                TranscriptKey.key_type == "youtube_video_id",
                TranscriptKey.key_value == episode.youtube_video_id,
            )
        ).scalar()
        if transcript_key and transcript_key.transcript:
            transcript = transcript_key.transcript
            transcript_info = AdminTranscriptInfo(
                transcript_id=transcript.transcript_id,
                source=transcript.source,
                language=transcript.language,
                blob_url=transcript.blob_url,
                created_at=transcript.created_at,
            )

    # Get summary info (most recent)
    summary = db.execute(
        select(Summary)
        .where(Summary.episode_id == episode_id)
        .order_by(Summary.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar()
    summary_info = None
    if summary:
        summary_info = AdminSummaryInfo(
            summary_id=summary.summary_id,
            model_id=summary.model_id,
            prompt_version=summary.prompt_version,
            blob_url=summary.blob_url,
            created_at=summary.created_at,
        )

    # Get delivery stats per status
    delivery_counts = db.execute(
        select(
            Delivery.status,
            func.count().label("count"),
        )
        .where(Delivery.episode_id == episode_id)
        .group_by(Delivery.status)
    ).all()

    # Build delivery stats dict
    stats_dict = {row.status: row.count for row in delivery_counts}
    delivery_stats = AdminDeliveryStats(
        pending=stats_dict.get("pending", 0),
        processing=stats_dict.get("processing", 0),
        sent=stats_dict.get("sent", 0),
        failed=stats_dict.get("failed", 0),
    )

    return AdminEpisodeDetail(
        episode_id=episode.episode_id,
        title=episode.title,
        channel_name=channel.name if channel else "Unknown",
        channel_id=episode.channel_id,
        source_type=episode.source_type,
        youtube_video_id=episode.youtube_video_id,
        audio_url=episode.audio_url,
        external_url=episode.external_url,
        published_at=episode.published_at,
        transcript=transcript_info,
        summary=summary_info,
        delivery_stats=delivery_stats,
        created_at=episode.created_at,
    )


@router.post("/{episode_id}/reprocess")
def reprocess_episode(
    episode_id: UUID,
    body: AdminReprocessRequest,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Trigger reprocessing of an episode.

    TODO: Implement actual job trigger. This is a placeholder that will
    be connected to the batch processor when that system is extended
    to support on-demand reprocessing.
    """
    episode = _get_episode_or_404(db, episode_id)

    if not body.reprocess_transcript and not body.reprocess_summary:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="At least one of reprocess_transcript or reprocess_summary must be true",
        )

    # TODO: Trigger actual reprocessing logic
    # For now, just return a placeholder response
    actions = []
    if body.reprocess_transcript:
        actions.append("transcript")
    if body.reprocess_summary:
        actions.append("summary")

    return {
        "status": "accepted",
        "message": f"Reprocessing request accepted for episode '{episode.title or episode.episode_id}'",
        "episode_id": str(episode.episode_id),
        "actions": ", ".join(actions),
    }


@router.delete("/{episode_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_episode(
    episode_id: UUID,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> None:
    """Delete an episode."""
    episode = _get_episode_or_404(db, episode_id)
    db.delete(episode)
    db.commit()

    # Transcript keys by youtube_video_id
    yt_transcript_exists_subq = (
        select(TranscriptKey.key_value.label("video_id"))
        .where(TranscriptKey.key_type == "youtube_video_id")
        .distinct()
        .subquery()
    )
    # Transcript keys by audio_url
    audio_transcript_exists_subq = (
        select(TranscriptKey.key_value.label("audio_url"))
        .where(TranscriptKey.key_type == "audio_url")
        .distinct()
        .subquery()
    )
    summary_exists_subq = select(Summary.episode_id.label("ep_id")).distinct().subquery()

    # Main query with flags computed via LEFT OUTER JOINs
    query = (
        select(
            Episode,
            # Has transcript if either youtube_video_id OR audio_url matches
            case(
                (yt_transcript_exists_subq.c.video_id.isnot(None), True),
                (audio_transcript_exists_subq.c.audio_url.isnot(None), True),
                else_=False,
            ).label("has_transcript"),
            case(
                (summary_exists_subq.c.ep_id.isnot(None), True),
                else_=False,
            ).label("has_summary"),
        )
        .outerjoin(
            yt_transcript_exists_subq,
            Episode.youtube_video_id == yt_transcript_exists_subq.c.video_id,
        )
        .outerjoin(
            audio_transcript_exists_subq,
            Episode.audio_url == audio_transcript_exists_subq.c.audio_url,
        )
        .outerjoin(
            summary_exists_subq,
            Episode.episode_id == summary_exists_subq.c.ep_id,
        )
        .options(joinedload(Episode.channel))
    )

    if filters:
        query = query.where(*filters)

    # Order and paginate
    query = query.order_by(
        case((Episode.published_at.is_(None), 1), else_=0),
        Episode.published_at.desc(),
    )
    query = query.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)

    results = db.execute(query).unique().all()

    # Build response
    items = [
        AdminEpisodeSummary(
            episode_id=row.Episode.episode_id,
            title=row.Episode.title,
            channel_name=row.Episode.channel.name if row.Episode.channel else "Unknown",
            source_type=row.Episode.source_type,
            published_at=row.Episode.published_at,
            has_transcript=row.has_transcript,
            has_summary=row.has_summary,
            created_at=row.Episode.created_at,
        )
        for row in results
    ]

    pages = (total + page_size - 1) // page_size if total > 0 else 0

    return PaginatedResponse(
        items=[item.model_dump() for item in items],
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        pages=pages,
    )


@router.get("/{episode_id}", response_model=AdminEpisodeDetail)
def get_episode(
    episode_id: UUID,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> AdminEpisodeDetail:
    """Get episode details with transcript info, summary info, and delivery stats."""
    # Load episode with channel
    episode = db.execute(
        select(Episode).options(joinedload(Episode.channel)).where(Episode.episode_id == episode_id)
    ).scalar()

    if not episode:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Episode not found")

    channel = episode.channel

    # Get transcript info via youtube_video_id
    transcript_info = None
    if episode.youtube_video_id:
        transcript_key = db.execute(
            select(TranscriptKey)
            .options(joinedload(TranscriptKey.transcript))
            .where(
                TranscriptKey.key_type == "youtube_video_id",
                TranscriptKey.key_value == episode.youtube_video_id,
            )
        ).scalar()
        if transcript_key and transcript_key.transcript:
            transcript = transcript_key.transcript
            transcript_info = AdminTranscriptInfo(
                transcript_id=transcript.transcript_id,
                source=transcript.source,
                language=transcript.language,
                blob_url=transcript.blob_url,
                created_at=transcript.created_at,
            )

    # Get summary info (most recent)
    summary = db.execute(
        select(Summary)
        .where(Summary.episode_id == episode_id)
        .order_by(Summary.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar()
    summary_info = None
    if summary:
        summary_info = AdminSummaryInfo(
            summary_id=summary.summary_id,
            model_id=summary.model_id,
            prompt_version=summary.prompt_version,
            blob_url=summary.blob_url,
            created_at=summary.created_at,
        )

    # Get delivery stats per status
    delivery_counts = db.execute(
        select(
            Delivery.status,
            func.count().label("count"),
        )
        .where(Delivery.episode_id == episode_id)
        .group_by(Delivery.status)
    ).all()

    # Build delivery stats dict
    stats_dict = {row.status: row.count for row in delivery_counts}
    delivery_stats = AdminDeliveryStats(
        pending=stats_dict.get("pending", 0),
        processing=stats_dict.get("processing", 0),
        sent=stats_dict.get("sent", 0),
        failed=stats_dict.get("failed", 0),
    )

    return AdminEpisodeDetail(
        episode_id=episode.episode_id,
        title=episode.title,
        channel_name=channel.name if channel else "Unknown",
        channel_id=episode.channel_id,
        source_type=episode.source_type,
        youtube_video_id=episode.youtube_video_id,
        audio_url=episode.audio_url,
        external_url=episode.external_url,
        published_at=episode.published_at,
        transcript=transcript_info,
        summary=summary_info,
        delivery_stats=delivery_stats,
        created_at=episode.created_at,
    )


@router.post("/{episode_id}/reprocess")
def reprocess_episode(
    episode_id: UUID,
    body: AdminReprocessRequest,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Trigger reprocessing of an episode.

    TODO: Implement actual job trigger. This is a placeholder that will
    be connected to the batch processor when that system is extended
    to support on-demand reprocessing.
    """
    episode = _get_episode_or_404(db, episode_id)

    if not body.reprocess_transcript and not body.reprocess_summary:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="At least one of reprocess_transcript or reprocess_summary must be true",
        )

    # TODO: Trigger actual reprocessing logic
    # For now, just return a placeholder response
    actions = []
    if body.reprocess_transcript:
        actions.append("transcript")
    if body.reprocess_summary:
        actions.append("summary")

    return {
        "status": "accepted",
        "message": f"Reprocessing request accepted for episode '{episode.title or episode.episode_id}'",
        "episode_id": str(episode.episode_id),
        "actions": ", ".join(actions),
    }


@router.delete("/{episode_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_episode(
    episode_id: UUID,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> None:
    """Delete an episode."""
    episode = _get_episode_or_404(db, episode_id)
    db.delete(episode)
    db.commit()

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`

- `audio_url` → for RSS podcast episodes

**Impact**: Once deployed, your dashboard should show ~3,461 transcribed episodes instead of just the 73 Dwarkesh YouTube episodes.

# Brainstorming Ideas Into Designs

## Overview

Help turn ideas into fully formed designs and specs through natural collaborative dialogue.

Start by understanding the current project context, then ask questions one at a time to refine the idea. Once you understand what you're building, present the design in small sections (200-300 words), checking after each section whether it looks right so far.

## The Process

**Understanding the idea:**
- Check out the current project state first (files, docs, recent commits)
- Ask questions one at a time to refine the idea
- Prefer multiple choice questions when possible, but open-ended is fine too
- Only one question per message - if a topic needs more exploration, break it into multiple questions
- Focus on understanding: purpose, constraints, success criteria

**Exploring approaches:**
- Propose 2-3 different approaches with trade-offs
- Present options conversationally with your recommendation and reasoning
- Lead with your recommended option and explain why

**Presenting the design:**
- Once you believe you understand what you're building, present the design
- Break it into sections of 200-300 words
- Ask after each section whether it looks right so far
- Cover: architecture, components, data flow, error handling, testing
- Be ready to go back and clarify if something doesn't make sense

## After the Design

**Documentation:**
- Write the validated design to `docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md`
- Use elements-of-style:writing-clearly-and-concisely skill if available
- Commit the design document to git

**Implementation (if continuing):**
- Ask: "Ready to set up for implementation?"
- Use superpowers:using-git-worktrees to create isolated workspace
- Use superpowers:writing-plans to create detailed implementation plan

## Key Principles

- **One question at a time** - Don't overwhelm with multiple questions
- **Multiple choice preferred** - Easier to answer than open-ended when possible
- **YAGNI ruthlessly** - Remove unnecessary features from all designs
- **Explore alternatives** - Always propose 2-3 approaches before settling
- **Incremental validation** - Present design in sections, validate each
- **Be flexible** - Go back and clarify when something doesn't make sense

# Channel Metadata Editing Design

**Date:** 2025-12-29
**Status:** Approved

## Overview

Allow admins to edit channel metadata (name, description, category, image URL, listen URL) through the admin dashboard while protecting operational fields that affect workflows.

## Field Classification

### Editable Metadata
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `name` | string | Display name |
| `description` | text | Channel description |
| `category` | string | e.g., "Technology", "Science" |
| `image_url` | string | Custom thumbnail/logo URL |
| `listen_url` | string | "Listen on Spotify/Apple" link |
| `is_active` | boolean | Pauses discovery when false |

### Read-Only Operational Fields
| Field | Reason |
|-------|--------|
| `channel_id` | Primary key |
| `type` | Determines workflow (youtube/podcast) |
| `youtube_channel_id` | Used for YouTube API fetching |
| `youtube_playlist_id` | Used for playlist fetching |
| `rss_feed_url` | Used for RSS feed polling |
| `last_episode_at` | System-managed |
| `created_at` | System-managed |

## Backend Changes

### Schema Update (`src/api/admin/schemas.py`)

Add two fields to `AdminChannelUpdate`:

```python
class AdminChannelUpdate(BaseModel):
    """Update channel request."""
    name: str | None = None
    category: str | None = None
    description: str | None = None
    image_url: str | None = None      # NEW
    listen_url: str | None = None     # NEW
    is_active: bool | None = None
```

No other backend changes needed—the existing PATCH endpoint applies all schema fields to the model.

## Frontend Changes

### Channel Detail Page

Add "Edit Channel" button that opens a modal/drawer with form fields:

- **Name**: Text input (required)
- **Description**: Textarea (optional)
- **Category**: Text input or dropdown (optional)
- **Image URL**: Text input with preview (optional)
- **Listen URL**: Text input (optional)
- **Active**: Toggle switch

Display read-only fields (channel ID, type, YouTube ID, RSS URL, etc.) as non-editable info below the form.

## Implementation Tasks

1. Add `image_url` and `listen_url` to `AdminChannelUpdate` schema
2. Add edit button to frontend channel detail page
3. Create edit modal/form component
4. Wire up PATCH API call on form submit
5. Show success/error feedback
