from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Dashboard
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


class DashboardStats(BaseModel):
    """Dashboard statistics."""

    pending_count: int
    processing_count: int
    sent_24h_count: int
    failed_count: int
    oldest_pending_hours: float | None
    gpu_fail_loops: int
    last_gpu_attempt: str  # "t4", "a100", or "none"
    last_poller_run: datetime | None
    last_controller_run: datetime | None
    last_processor_run: datetime | None
    db_connected: bool
    # Cookie health tracking
    cookie_status: str  # "healthy", "warning", "expired"
    cookie_last_success: datetime | None
    cookie_consecutive_failures: int


class ErrorSummary(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated error summary."""

    message: str
    count: int
    last_seen: datetime


class DashboardErrors(BaseModel):
    """Dashboard error aggregation."""

    errors: list[ErrorSummary]
    total_failed_24h: int


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Users
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


class AdminUserSummary(BaseModel):
    """User summary for list view."""

    user_id: UUID
    email: EmailStr
    tier: str
    is_admin: bool
    created_at: datetime
    subscription_count: int
    sent_delivery_count: int

    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}


class AdminSubscriptionSummary(BaseModel):
    """Subscription summary for user detail."""

    subscription_id: UUID
    channel_name: str
    channel_type: str
    created_at: datetime

    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}


class AdminDeliverySummary(BaseModel):
    """Delivery summary for list view."""

    delivery_id: UUID
    episode_title: str | None
    channel_name: str
    user_email: str
    status: str
    attempts: int
    last_error: str | None
    created_at: datetime
    sent_at: datetime | None

    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}


class AdminUserDetail(BaseModel):
    """Detailed user view."""

    user_id: UUID
    email: EmailStr
    tier: str
    is_admin: bool
    created_at: datetime
    subscriptions: list[AdminSubscriptionSummary]
    recent_deliveries: list[AdminDeliverySummary]

    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}

# Channels

    """Channel summary for list view."""

    channel_id: UUID
    name: str
    type: str
    category: str | None
    is_active: bool
    subscriber_count: int
    episode_count: int
    transcribed_count: int
    summarized_count: int
    last_episode_at: datetime | None
    created_at: datetime | None

    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}

    name: str
    type: str
    category: str | None
    description: str | None

    youtube_playlist_id: str | None

"""Admin channel management endpoints."""

from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select

from src.api.admin.schemas import (
    AdminChannelCreate,
    AdminChannelDetail,
    AdminChannelSummary,
    AdminChannelUpdate,
    PaginatedResponse,
)
from src.api.dependencies import AdminUser, DbSession
from src.db.models import Channel, Episode, Subscription, Summary, TranscriptKey

router = APIRouter()


def _get_channel_or_404(db: DbSession, channel_id: UUID) -> Channel:
    """Get a channel by ID or raise 404."""
    channel = db.execute(select(Channel).where(Channel.channel_id == channel_id)).scalar()
    if not channel:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Channel not found")
    return channel


def _build_channel_detail(db: DbSession, channel: Channel) -> AdminChannelDetail:
    """Build AdminChannelDetail from a Channel model."""
    # Combine all counts into a single query
    stats = db.execute(
        select(
            func.coalesce(
                select(func.count())
                .where(Subscription.channel_id == channel.channel_id)
                .correlate(None)
                .scalar_subquery(),
                0,
            ).label("subscriber_count"),
            func.coalesce(
                select(func.count())
                .where(Episode.channel_id == channel.channel_id)
                .correlate(None)
                .scalar_subquery(),
                0,
            ).label("episode_count"),
            select(func.max(Episode.published_at))
            .where(Episode.channel_id == channel.channel_id)
            .correlate(None)
            .scalar_subquery()
            .label("last_episode_at"),
        )
    ).one()

    return AdminChannelDetail(
        channel_id=channel.channel_id,
        name=channel.name,
        type=channel.type,
        category=channel.category,
        description=channel.description,
        youtube_channel_id=channel.youtube_channel_id,
        youtube_playlist_id=channel.youtube_playlist_id,
        rss_feed_url=channel.rss_feed_url,
        is_active=channel.is_active,
        subscriber_count=stats.subscriber_count,
        episode_count=stats.episode_count,
        last_episode_at=stats.last_episode_at,
        created_at=channel.created_at,
    )


@router.get("", response_model=PaginatedResponse)
def list_channels(
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    search: str | None = None,
    type: str | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by channel type"),
    is_active: bool | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by active status"),
) -> PaginatedResponse:
    """List all channels with pagination and filters."""
    # Build filter conditions
    filters: list[Any] = []
    if search:
        filters.append(Channel.name.ilike(f"%{search}%"))
    if type:
        filters.append(Channel.type == type)
    if is_active is not None:
        filters.append(Channel.is_active == is_active)

    # Get total count
    count_query = select(func.count()).select_from(Channel)
    if filters:
        count_query = count_query.where(*filters)
    total = db.execute(count_query).scalar() or 0

    # Subqueries for aggregated counts (executed once, not per-channel)
    subscriber_subq = (
        select(
            Subscription.channel_id,
            func.count().label("count"),
        )
        .group_by(Subscription.channel_id)
        .subquery()
    )

    episode_stats_subq = (
        select(
            Episode.channel_id,
            func.count().label("episode_count"),
            func.max(Episode.published_at).label("last_episode_at"),
        )
        .group_by(Episode.channel_id)
        .subquery()
    )

    # Transcribed count: episodes with matching TranscriptKey (via youtube_video_id OR audio_url)
    transcribed_subq = (
        select(
            Episode.channel_id,
            func.count(func.distinct(Episode.episode_id)).label("count"),
        )
        .join(
            TranscriptKey,
            or_(
                and_(
                    TranscriptKey.key_type == "youtube_video_id",
                    TranscriptKey.key_value == Episode.youtube_video_id,
                ),
                and_(
                    TranscriptKey.key_type == "audio_url",
                    TranscriptKey.key_value == Episode.audio_url,
                ),
            ),
        )
        .group_by(Episode.channel_id)
        .subquery()
    )

    # Summarized count: episodes with summaries
    summarized_subq = (
        select(
            Episode.channel_id,
            func.count(func.distinct(Summary.episode_id)).label("count"),
        )
        .select_from(Summary)
        .join(Episode)
        .group_by(Episode.channel_id)
        .subquery()
    )

    # Main query with all subqueries joined
    query = (
        select(
            Channel,
            func.coalesce(subscriber_subq.c.count, 0).label("subscriber_count"),
            func.coalesce(episode_stats_subq.c.episode_count, 0).label("episode_count"),
            episode_stats_subq.c.last_episode_at,
            func.coalesce(transcribed_subq.c.count, 0).label("transcribed_count"),
            func.coalesce(summarized_subq.c.count, 0).label("summarized_count"),
        )
        .outerjoin(subscriber_subq, Channel.channel_id == subscriber_subq.c.channel_id)
        .outerjoin(episode_stats_subq, Channel.channel_id == episode_stats_subq.c.channel_id)
        .outerjoin(transcribed_subq, Channel.channel_id == transcribed_subq.c.channel_id)
        .outerjoin(summarized_subq, Channel.channel_id == summarized_subq.c.channel_id)
    )

    if filters:
        query = query.where(*filters)

    # Order and paginate
    query = query.order_by(Channel.created_at.desc())
    query = query.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)

    results = db.execute(query).all()

    # Build response
    items = [
        AdminChannelSummary(
            channel_id=row.Channel.channel_id,
            name=row.Channel.name,
            type=row.Channel.type,
            category=row.Channel.category,
            is_active=row.Channel.is_active,
            subscriber_count=row.subscriber_count,
            episode_count=row.episode_count,
            transcribed_count=row.transcribed_count,
            summarized_count=row.summarized_count,
            last_episode_at=row.last_episode_at,
            created_at=row.Channel.created_at,
        )
        for row in results
    ]

    pages = (total + page_size - 1) // page_size if total > 0 else 0

    return PaginatedResponse(
        items=[item.model_dump() for item in items],
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        pages=pages,
    )


@router.get("/{channel_id}", response_model=AdminChannelDetail)
def get_channel(
    channel_id: UUID,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> AdminChannelDetail:
    """Get channel details."""
    channel = _get_channel_or_404(db, channel_id)
    return _build_channel_detail(db, channel)


@router.post("", response_model=AdminChannelDetail, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_channel(
    body: AdminChannelCreate,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> AdminChannelDetail:
    """Create a new channel."""
    # Validate type
    if body.type not in ("youtube", "podcast"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Type must be 'youtube' or 'podcast'")

    channel = Channel(
        type=body.type,
        name=body.name,
        category=body.category,
        description=body.description,
        youtube_channel_id=body.youtube_channel_id,
        youtube_playlist_id=body.youtube_playlist_id,
        rss_feed_url=body.rss_feed_url,
        is_active=True,  # Default to active
    )
    db.add(channel)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(channel)

    return _build_channel_detail(db, channel)


@router.patch("/{channel_id}", response_model=AdminChannelDetail)
def update_channel(
    channel_id: UUID,
    body: AdminChannelUpdate,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> AdminChannelDetail:
    """Update a channel (partial update)."""
    channel = _get_channel_or_404(db, channel_id)

    # Apply updates
    update_data = body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    for field, value in update_data.items():
        setattr(channel, field, value)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(channel)

    return _build_channel_detail(db, channel)


@router.delete("/{channel_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_channel(
    channel_id: UUID,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> None:
    """Delete a channel."""
    channel = _get_channel_or_404(db, channel_id)
    db.delete(channel)
    db.commit()


@router.post("/{channel_id}/poll")
def poll_channel(
    channel_id: UUID,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Trigger immediate poll for a channel.

    TODO: Implement actual polling logic. This is a placeholder that will
    be connected to the discovery poller when that system is extended
    to support on-demand polling.
    """
    channel = _get_channel_or_404(db, channel_id)

    # TODO: Trigger actual polling logic
    # For now, just return a placeholder response
    return {
        "status": "accepted",
        "message": f"Poll request accepted for channel '{channel.name}'",
        "channel_id": str(channel.channel_id),
    }

"""Admin user management endpoints."""

import secrets
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import joinedload

from src.api.admin.schemas import (
    AdminDeliverySummary,
    AdminSubscriptionSummary,
    AdminUserDetail,
    AdminUserSummary,
    PaginatedResponse,
)
from src.api.dependencies import AdminUser, DbSession
from src.config import get_settings
from src.db.models import AuthToken, Delivery, Subscription, User

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("", response_model=PaginatedResponse)
def list_users(
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    search: str | None = None,
) -> PaginatedResponse:
    """List all users with pagination."""
    # Build filter conditions
    filters = []
    if search:
        filters.append(User.email.ilike(f"%{search}%"))

    # Get total count
    count_query = select(func.count()).select_from(User)
    if filters:
        count_query = count_query.where(*filters)
    total = db.execute(count_query).scalar() or 0

    # Subquery for subscription count per user
    subscription_subq = (
        select(
            Subscription.user_id,
            func.count().label("count"),
        )
        .group_by(Subscription.user_id)
        .subquery()
    )

    # Subquery for sent delivery count per user
    sent_delivery_subq = (
        select(
            Subscription.user_id,
            func.count().label("count"),
        )
        .select_from(Delivery)
        .join(Subscription)
        .where(Delivery.status == "sent")
        .group_by(Subscription.user_id)
        .subquery()
    )

    # Main query with all subqueries joined
    query = (
        select(
            User,
            func.coalesce(subscription_subq.c.count, 0).label("subscription_count"),
            func.coalesce(sent_delivery_subq.c.count, 0).label("sent_delivery_count"),
        )
        .outerjoin(subscription_subq, User.user_id == subscription_subq.c.user_id)
        .outerjoin(sent_delivery_subq, User.user_id == sent_delivery_subq.c.user_id)
    )

    if filters:
        query = query.where(*filters)

    # Order and paginate
    query = query.order_by(User.created_at.desc())
    query = query.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)

    results = db.execute(query).all()

    # Build response
    items = [
        AdminUserSummary(
            user_id=row.User.user_id,
            email=row.User.email,
            tier=row.User.tier,
            is_admin=row.User.is_admin,
            created_at=row.User.created_at,
            subscription_count=row.subscription_count,
            sent_delivery_count=row.sent_delivery_count,
        )
        for row in results
    ]

    pages = (total + page_size - 1) // page_size

    return PaginatedResponse(
        items=[item.model_dump() for item in items],
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        pages=pages,
    )


@router.get("/{user_id}", response_model=AdminUserDetail)
def get_user(
    user_id: UUID,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> AdminUserDetail:
    """Get user details."""
    user = db.execute(
        select(User)
        .options(joinedload(User.subscriptions).joinedload(Subscription.channel))
        .where(User.user_id == user_id)
    ).scalar()

    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User not found")

    # Get subscriptions
    subscriptions = [
        AdminSubscriptionSummary(
            subscription_id=sub.subscription_id,
            channel_name=sub.channel.name,
            channel_type=sub.channel.type,
            created_at=sub.created_at,
        )
        for sub in user.subscriptions
    ]

    # Get recent deliveries
    deliveries_stmt = (
        select(Delivery)
        .join(Subscription)
        .options(joinedload(Delivery.episode))
        .where(Subscription.user_id == user_id)
        .order_by(Delivery.created_at.desc())
        .limit(10)
    )
    deliveries = db.execute(deliveries_stmt).scalars().all()

    recent_deliveries = [
        AdminDeliverySummary(
            delivery_id=d.delivery_id,
            episode_title=d.episode.title if d.episode else None,
            channel_name=(
                d.subscription.channel.name
                if d.subscription and d.subscription.channel
                else "Unknown"
            ),
            user_email=user.email,
            status=d.status,
            attempts=d.attempts,
            last_error=d.last_error,
            created_at=d.created_at,
            sent_at=d.sent_at,
        )
        for d in deliveries
    ]

    return AdminUserDetail(
        user_id=user.user_id,
        email=user.email,
        tier=user.tier,
        is_admin=user.is_admin,
        created_at=user.created_at,
        subscriptions=subscriptions,
        recent_deliveries=recent_deliveries,
    )


@router.delete("/{user_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_user(
    user_id: UUID,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> None:
    """Delete a user and all their data."""
    user = db.execute(select(User).where(User.user_id == user_id)).scalar()

    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User not found")

    if user.user_id == admin.user_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Cannot delete yourself")

    db.delete(user)
    db.commit()


@router.post("/{user_id}/impersonate")
def impersonate_user(
    user_id: UUID,
    admin: AdminUser,
    db: DbSession,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Generate an impersonation token for a user."""
    user = db.execute(select(User).where(User.user_id == user_id)).scalar()

    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User not found")

    settings = get_settings()

    # Create a short-lived token for impersonation
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    auth_token = AuthToken(
        token=token,
        user_id=user.user_id,

"""Subscription management endpoints."""

import logging
from datetime import datetime
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, BackgroundTasks, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import joinedload

from src.api.dependencies import CurrentUser, DbSession
from src.db.models import Channel, Delivery, Episode, Subscription
from src.services.discovery import get_discovery_service
from src.services.queue import (
    estimate_ready_time,
    get_delivery_queue_position,
    get_next_batch_time,
)
from src.tier_limits import get_tier_limits

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter()


class SubscriptionResponse(BaseModel):
    """Subscription details."""

    subscription_id: UUID
    channel_id: UUID
    channel_name: str
    channel_type: str
    backfill_limit: int
    created_at: str
    image_url: str | None = None
    last_episode_at: datetime | None = None
    listen_url: str | None = None
    episode_count: int = 0

    class Config:
        from_attributes = True


class SubscriptionListResponse(BaseModel):
    """List of subscriptions."""

    subscriptions: list[SubscriptionResponse]
    total: int


class CreateSubscriptionRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request to create a subscription."""

    channel_id: UUID


class CreateSubscriptionResponse(BaseModel):
    """Response for subscription creation."""

    subscription_id: UUID
    message: str


class BackfillRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request to backfill episodes."""

    limit: int = 5


class BackfillResponse(BaseModel):
    """Response for backfill request."""

    episodes_queued: int
    message: str


class EpisodeResponse(BaseModel):
    """Episode with status for a subscription."""

    episode_id: UUID
    title: str | None
    published_at: datetime | None
    duration_seconds: int | None = None
    description: str | None = None
    status: str  # 'sent', 'pending', 'available'
    queue_position: int | None = None
    next_batch_at: datetime | None = None
    estimated_ready_at: datetime | None = None


class EpisodeListResponse(BaseModel):
    """Paginated list of episodes."""

    episodes: list[EpisodeResponse]
    total: int
    page: int
    per_page: int


class RequestEpisodeRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request to queue an episode for summary."""

    episode_id: UUID


class RequestEpisodeResponse(BaseModel):
    """Response for episode request."""

    queued: bool
    message: str


@router.get("", response_model=SubscriptionListResponse)
async def list_subscriptions(
    db: DbSession,
    user: CurrentUser,
) -> SubscriptionListResponse:
    """List user's subscriptions."""
    # Subquery to count episodes per channel
    episode_count_subq = (
        select(Episode.channel_id, func.count(Episode.episode_id).label("episode_count"))
        .group_by(Episode.channel_id)
        .subquery()
    )

    stmt = (
        select(
            Subscription,
            Channel,
            func.coalesce(episode_count_subq.c.episode_count, 0).label("episode_count"),
        )
        .join(Channel, Subscription.channel_id == Channel.channel_id)
        .outerjoin(episode_count_subq, Channel.channel_id == episode_count_subq.c.channel_id)
        .where(Subscription.user_id == user.user_id)
        .order_by(Subscription.created_at.desc())
    )
    results = db.execute(stmt).all()

    return SubscriptionListResponse(
        subscriptions=[
            SubscriptionResponse(
                subscription_id=s.subscription_id,
                channel_id=s.channel_id,
                channel_name=channel.name,
                channel_type=channel.type,
                backfill_limit=s.backfill_limit_default,
                created_at=s.created_at.isoformat(),
                image_url=channel.image_url,
                last_episode_at=channel.last_episode_at,
                listen_url=channel.listen_url,
                episode_count=episode_count,
            )
            for s, channel, episode_count in results
        ],
        total=len(results),
    )


@router.post("", response_model=CreateSubscriptionResponse)
async def create_subscription(
    request: CreateSubscriptionRequest,
    db: DbSession,
    user: CurrentUser,
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
) -> CreateSubscriptionResponse:
    """Subscribe to a channel.

    Automatically triggers backfill of recent episodes.
    """
    # Verify channel exists and is active
    stmt = select(Channel).where(
        Channel.channel_id == request.channel_id,
        Channel.is_active == True,  # noqa: E712
    )
    channel = db.execute(stmt).scalar_one_or_none()

    if not channel:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Channel not found",
        )

    # Check for existing subscription
    sub_stmt = select(Subscription).where(
        Subscription.user_id == user.user_id,
        Subscription.channel_id == request.channel_id,
    )
    existing = db.execute(sub_stmt).scalar_one_or_none()

    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Already subscribed to this channel",
        )

    # Check subscription limit (skip for admins)
    if not user.is_admin:
        limits = get_tier_limits(user.tier)
        if limits.max_subscriptions is not None:
            current_count_stmt = select(func.count(Subscription.subscription_id)).where(
                Subscription.user_id == user.user_id
            )
            current_count = db.execute(current_count_stmt).scalar() or 0

            if current_count >= limits.max_subscriptions:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                    detail=f"Subscription limit reached ({limits.max_subscriptions} max)",
                )

    # Create subscription
    subscription = Subscription(
        user_id=user.user_id,
        channel_id=request.channel_id,
    )
    db.add(subscription)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(subscription)

    logger.info(
        f"Subscription created: {subscription.subscription_id} "
        f"(user={user.email}, channel={channel.name})"
    )

    # Trigger backfill in background
    # Note: In production, this would be done by the batch processor
    # background_tasks.add_task(
    #     _backfill_subscription,
    #     subscription.subscription_id,
    # )

    return CreateSubscriptionResponse(
        subscription_id=subscription.subscription_id,
        message=f"Subscribed to {channel.name}. Recent episodes will be processed.",
    )


@router.post("/{subscription_id}/backfill", response_model=BackfillResponse)
async def backfill_subscription(
    subscription_id: UUID,
    request: BackfillRequest,
    db: DbSession,
    user: CurrentUser,
) -> BackfillResponse:
    """Manually trigger backfill of episodes for a subscription."""
    # Get subscription and verify ownership
    stmt = (
        select(Subscription)
        .options(joinedload(Subscription.channel))
        .where(
            Subscription.subscription_id == subscription_id,
            Subscription.user_id == user.user_id,
        )
    )
    subscription = db.execute(stmt).unique().scalar_one_or_none()

    if not subscription:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Subscription not found",
        )

    # Limit backfill to tier-based depth
    limits = get_tier_limits(user.tier)
    max_depth = limits.backfill_depth if not user.is_admin else 20
    limit = min(request.limit, max_depth)

    # Perform backfill
    try:
        discovery = get_discovery_service()
        episodes_queued = discovery.backfill_subscription(db, subscription, limit=limit)

        return BackfillResponse(
            episodes_queued=episodes_queued,
            message=f"Queued {episodes_queued} episodes for processing.",
        )

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Backfill failed for {subscription_id}: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail="Failed to backfill episodes",
        ) from e


@router.get("/{subscription_id}/episodes", response_model=EpisodeListResponse)
async def list_episodes(
    subscription_id: UUID,
    db: DbSession,
    user: CurrentUser,
    page: int = 1,
    per_page: int = 20,
) -> EpisodeListResponse:
    """List episodes for a subscription with status."""
    # Validate per_page
    per_page = min(per_page, 50)
    offset = (page - 1) * per_page

    # Verify subscription ownership
    sub_stmt = select(Subscription).where(
        Subscription.subscription_id == subscription_id,
        Subscription.user_id == user.user_id,
    )
    subscription = db.execute(sub_stmt).scalar_one_or_none()

    if not subscription:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Subscription not found",
        )

    # Get total count
    count_stmt = select(func.count(Episode.episode_id)).where(
        Episode.channel_id == subscription.channel_id
    )
    total = db.execute(count_stmt).scalar() or 0

    # Get episodes with delivery status
    episodes_stmt = (
        select(Episode)
        .where(Episode.channel_id == subscription.channel_id)
        .order_by(Episode.published_at.desc())
        .offset(offset)
        .limit(per_page)
    )
    episodes = db.execute(episodes_stmt).scalars().all()

    # Get delivery statuses for these episodes
    episode_ids = [e.episode_id for e in episodes]
    delivery_stmt = select(Delivery).where(
        Delivery.subscription_id == subscription_id,
        Delivery.episode_id.in_(episode_ids),
    )
    deliveries = db.execute(delivery_stmt).scalars().all()
    delivery_map = {d.episode_id: d for d in deliveries}

    # Pre-calculate next batch time for pending episodes
    next_batch = get_next_batch_time()

    def build_episode_response(episode: Episode) -> EpisodeResponse:
        delivery = delivery_map.get(episode.episode_id)
        status = delivery.status if delivery else "available"

        queue_position = None
        next_batch_at = None
        estimated_ready_at = None

        if delivery and delivery.status == "pending":
            queue_position = get_delivery_queue_position(db, delivery.delivery_id)
            if queue_position > 0:
                next_batch_at = next_batch
                estimated_ready_at = estimate_ready_time(next_batch, queue_position)

        return EpisodeResponse(
            episode_id=episode.episode_id,
            title=episode.title,
            published_at=episode.published_at,
            duration_seconds=None,  # Episode model doesn't have this yet
            description=None,  # Episode model doesn't have this yet
            status=status,
            queue_position=queue_position,
            next_batch_at=next_batch_at,
            estimated_ready_at=estimated_ready_at,
        )

    return EpisodeListResponse(
        episodes=[build_episode_response(e) for e in episodes],
        total=total,
        page=page,
        per_page=per_page,
    )


@router.post("/{subscription_id}/episodes/request", response_model=RequestEpisodeResponse)
async def request_episode_summary(
    subscription_id: UUID,
    request: RequestEpisodeRequest,
    db: DbSession,
    user: CurrentUser,
) -> RequestEpisodeResponse:
    """Request a summary for a specific episode."""
    from datetime import date

    from src.db.models import UserUsage
    from src.tier_limits import get_tier_limits

    # Verify subscription ownership
    sub_stmt = (
        select(Subscription)
        .options(joinedload(Subscription.channel))
        .where(
            Subscription.subscription_id == subscription_id,
            Subscription.user_id == user.user_id,
        )
    )
    subscription = db.execute(sub_stmt).unique().scalar_one_or_none()

    if not subscription:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Subscription not found",
        )

    # Verify episode belongs to this channel
    ep_stmt = select(Episode).where(
        Episode.episode_id == request.episode_id,
        Episode.channel_id == subscription.channel_id,
    )
    episode = db.execute(ep_stmt).scalar_one_or_none()

    if not episode:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Episode not found in this channel",
        )

    # Check for existing delivery
    existing_stmt = select(Delivery).where(
        Delivery.subscription_id == subscription_id,
        Delivery.episode_id == request.episode_id,
    )
    existing = db.execute(existing_stmt).scalar_one_or_none()

    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail=f"Episode already {existing.status}",
        )

    # Check tier limits (skip for admins)
    if not user.is_admin:
        limits = get_tier_limits(user.tier)
        if limits.max_requests_per_month is not None:
            # Get current month's usage
            current_month = date.today().replace(day=1)
            usage_stmt = select(UserUsage).where(
                UserUsage.user_id == user.user_id,
                UserUsage.month == current_month,
            )
            usage = db.execute(usage_stmt).scalar_one_or_none()
            current_count = usage.episode_requests_count if usage else 0

            if current_count >= limits.max_requests_per_month:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                    detail="Monthly request limit reached",
                )

    # Create delivery
    delivery = Delivery(
        subscription_id=subscription_id,
        episode_id=request.episode_id,
        status="pending",
    )
    db.add(delivery)

    # Update usage count (skip for admins)
    if not user.is_admin:
        current_month = date.today().replace(day=1)
        usage_stmt = select(UserUsage).where(
            UserUsage.user_id == user.user_id,
            UserUsage.month == current_month,
        )
        usage = db.execute(usage_stmt).scalar_one_or_none()

        if usage:
            usage.episode_requests_count += 1
        else:
            usage = UserUsage(
                user_id=user.user_id,
                month=current_month,
                episode_requests_count=1,
            )
            db.add(usage)

    db.commit()

    logger.info(f"Episode requested: {episode.title} for subscription {subscription_id}")

    return RequestEpisodeResponse(
        queued=True,
        message="Episode queued for processing",
    )
